text: Wrote to Prof. Alvarez proposing Wednesday 10:00–10:30, mentioning the cancelled senate meeting. I'll put it on his calendar as soon as he confirms — or adjust the time if he prefers another slot.

Heads-up before anything gets booked: the department office says the **Wednesday 10:00 Faculty Senate meeting is still on** — nothing cancelled or moved that week in the official schedule.

So I haven't put anything on the calendar and told Prof. Alvarez to hold off on 10:00; I offered him Wednesday 11:00, Wednesday 14:00, or Thursday 10:00 instead. I'll book and invite as soon as he picks one.

Done: with Wednesday 10:00 off the table (senate confirmed still on), I picked **Wednesday, November 25, 12:30–13:00** from the windows Alvarez gave me (Wed 12:30–14:00 / 15:00–17:00, Thu 12:00–14:00) and sent him the calendar invitation. I also set myself a reminder for 12:15 that day.
Done — meeting with Prof. Alvarez set for Wednesday, November 25, 12:30–13:00, his office; invitation accepted. Nothing to do on your side.
